definitionEn: To change the time of a planned event.

example.en: Can we reschedule the software interview to 2 p.m.?
example.ko: 소프트웨어 인터뷰를 오후 2시로 변경할 수 있을까요?

definitionEn: Free to meet or able to be used.

example.en: Is the project manager available this afternoon?
example.ko: 프로젝트 매니저가 오늘 오후에 시간이 되나요?

definitionEn: A person who attends a meeting.

example.en: Please add all attendees to the attendance list.
example.ko: 참석자 명단에 모든 참석자를 추가해 주세요.

definitionEn: The written record of what was said and decided in a meeting.

example.en: Who will take the minutes today?

pitfall: '분(시간)'과 같은 단어. 회의록 뜻일 때는 항상 복수형.

definitionEn: A product or document that must be delivered.

example.en: The safety case is one of the deliverables to the OEM.
example.ko: 세이프티 케이스는 OEM에 제출할 납품물 중 하나입니다.

definitionEn: An important point in a project schedule.

example.en: Which safety work products are required at the C-sample milestone?
example.ko: C샘플 마일스톤에 어떤 안전 산출물이 필요합니까?

definitionEn: The first meeting at the start of a project.

example.en: Was functional safety discussed at the project kick-off meeting?

definitionEn: A person or group affected by or involved in a project.

example.en: Were all stakeholders involved in the requirements review?

definitionEn: People, money or equipment available for work.

example.en: Do you have enough resources for the safety activities?

definitionEn: The time between ordering and receiving something.

example.en: The lead time for the new microcontroller is 26 weeks.

definitionEn: An early model built for testing.

example.en: Were these tests done on a prototype or on series hardware?
example.ko: 이 시험은 시제품으로 했습니까, 양산 하드웨어로 했습니까?

definitionEn: Samples from different development stages, from first function to near-production.

example.en: Which software version runs on the B-sample?

localTip: 독일 업계에서 매우 흔한 용어(A-Muster, B-Muster). 독일 엔지니어가 'Muster'라고 말할 수도 있다.

definitionEn: The date when series production starts.

example.en: When is the SOP for this project?

pitfall: SOP가 '표준 작업 절차(Standard Operating Procedure)'를 뜻할 때도 있다. 맥락으로 구분.

definitionEn: The period when production volume increases after the start.

example.en: Are there additional checks during the production ramp-up?
example.ko: 양산 초기 증산 기간에 추가 점검이 있습니까?

definitionEn: Production of large quantities of a product.

example.en: This product has been in mass production since 2024.

definitionEn: A fault in a product.

example.en: How many defects were found in the software reviews?
example.ko: 소프트웨어 리뷰에서 결함이 몇 개 발견되었습니까?

definitionEn: The number of defective parts per one million parts.

example.en: The field failure rate is below 1 ppm.

definitionEn: When a company asks customers to return a faulty product.

example.en: Has this product ever been involved in a recall?
example.ko: 이 제품이 리콜에 연루된 적이 있습니까?

definitionEn: A report from a customer about a problem with a product.

example.en: How are customer complaints related to safety handled?
example.ko: 안전 관련 고객 클레임은 어떻게 처리합니까?

meaningKo: 품질 게이트 (단계 전환 전 점검 시점)
definitionEn: A checkpoint where criteria must be met before the next phase.

example.en: Is the confirmation review a criterion at the quality gate?
example.ko: 확인 리뷰가 품질 게이트의 기준에 포함됩니까?

definitionEn: A company that provides products or services to another company.

example.en: How do you monitor your suppliers for functional safety?

definitionEn: A company hired by another company to do part of its work.

example.en: Is part of the software developed by a subcontractor?

definitionEn: In the auto industry, the vehicle manufacturer.

example.en: Was the HARA provided by the OEM?

definitionEn: A supplier that delivers directly to the OEM.

example.en: As a Tier 1, you are responsible for the system-level analysis.
example.ko: 1차 협력사로서 시스템 수준 분석은 귀사 책임입니다.

definitionEn: The main office of a company.

example.en: Is the safety department located at headquarters?

definitionEn: At the location where the work happens.

example.en: Is the hardware team on site today?

definitionEn: From a different place, using the internet.

example.en: Can the test engineer join remotely?
example.ko: 시험 엔지니어가 원격으로 참여할 수 있습니까?

definitionEn: The difference in time between two places.

example.en: Because of the time difference, let's have the call at 9 a.m. German time.
example.ko: 시차 때문에 독일 시간 오전 9시에 통화합시다.

definitionEn: Away from work and not available.

example.en: The safety manager is out of office this week.
example.ko: 안전 관리자는 이번 주 부재 중입니다.

definitionEn: A small card with your name and contact details.

example.en: Here is my business card.

localTip: 독일에서는 명함을 두 손으로 건네는 의식이 없다. 한 손으로 간단히 주고받는 게 보통.

definitionEn: A person with the same role in another organization.

example.en: Who is my counterpart for functional safety on your side?

definitionEn: Responsible for something.

example.en: Who is in charge of configuration management?

definitionEn: The person to contact about a topic.

example.en: Who will be the point of contact for the action plan?
example.ko: 조치 계획의 연락 창구는 누가 맡습니까?

definitionEn: The number of people working in a team or company.

example.en: What is the headcount of the safety team?

definitionEn: The money available for a project.

example.en: Is there a budget for tool qualification?
